summary: No new managed CLI binding is safe from this intake. Every fixed-script or package-manager candidate is accounted for below.

intakeContract.backendSelection: The backend may select only a client-approved moduleId and installProfileId plus a structured source version summary.
officialScriptRequirements: official HTTPS source tied to an immutable tag or commit
no nested mutable remote script pipeline
fixed dependency identities, versions and integrity metadata
bounded cancellation, timeout, staging and failure cleanup
exact AI Hub receipt and no adoption of manual installs
owned terminal, update, repair, uninstall, rollback and data-preservation boundaries
packageManagerRequirements: client-fixed manager, package identity and version
deterministic command entry point and terminal launch
exact receipt, recheck, update, repair, uninstall and data-preservation boundaries
no adoption of an existing user-managed installation

decisions.requiredNextEvidence: Replace nested mutable dependency bootstraps with immutable, integrity-pinned artifacts and define exact runtime, repository, venv, PATH, gateway task, update, repair, rollback, uninstall and preserved-data ownership.
None for the CLI module; retain the desktop acquisition contract under the desktop owner.
Create and approve an independent first-class CLI product identity, then provide fixed version, source, integrity, entry-point, lifecycle and data-boundary evidence.

Create and approve an independent first-class CLI product identity, then pin the official npm version and prove scripts, entry point, update, repair, uninstall and data boundaries before reusing the npm driver.

blockers: No candidate satisfies both independent CLI identity and the complete fixed lifecycle contract.
No managed-official-script driver is proposed because the only script candidate violates the no-nested-mutable-bootstrap boundary.
No backend binding may be generated from this candidate.
